sounds.name: hover

sounds.name: ricochet

sounds.name: dry-fire

sounds.name: ice

sounds.name: slot-spin

sounds.name: jackpot

sounds.name: whisper

sounds.name: music-box

sounds.name: plant-seed

sounds.name: fishing-cast

sounds.name: access-denied

sounds.name: merge
